vignette: 62-year-old woman, current smoker, 1 pack/day for 35 years. No cough, hemoptysis, weight loss, or other respiratory symptoms. Requesting her first LDCT screening. Order on file from the primary care physician for lung cancer screening with LDCT. Reading radiologist is ABR board-certified. The imaging center reports nodules using Lung-RADS.
